needsDevice: Verify: Google, Apple and Facebook sign-in open a system browser or native sheet
Verify: Email code arrives from Supabase
Workout: Tab bar and scroll position are not rendered here
Player: Screen rotation and the backgrounded timer
Dance: Beat timing against the music tempo
CameraPermission: The real Android and iOS camera permission prompt
FormCheck: Camera preview and framing guide
LiveCheck: Real pose landmarks, frame rate and heat (casafit-pose module)
LiveCheck: Camera preview, mirrored front camera
CameraDenied: Opening system settings and coming back
Paywall: The Play Store or App Store purchase sheet
Paywall: Restore purchases against a real store account
Steps: The Health Connect permission screen
StepsPermission: Health Connect and motion permission prompts
ReverseTimer: Live step count, screen kept awake, haptic at the end
Notify: The real notification permission prompt and scheduled delivery
DeleteAccount: Server-side delete and sign-out (needs the real API)
notAudited: Splash has no controls and leaves by itself on a timer. Building runs a build on a timer and navigates by itself; only its one button is pressed.
Tab bar buttons and the native-stack header: owned by React Navigation, not by a screen. Maestro covers them.
Drag-to-reorder in the Editor: a native gesture. The up and down buttons are pressed.

Anything behind a native prompt (camera, Health Connect, notifications, store purchase sheet, Google or Apple sign-in): the audit presses the button and checks the app asks, but cannot answer the prompt.
Screens reached only through a state the seed cannot reach (for example a live pose stream with real landmarks).
